# Session 100a Plan — Wave 6: Stage-2 Verification Cohort (joint-theorem promotions)

**Date**: 2026-06-03
**Author**: gen-physicist (generated by /rclab-plan per-wave swarm)

## Wave 6 Summary

Wave 6 executes two **Stage-2 cross-axis independent-verify** gates from the open-channel-ledger §C "ready-to-execute" queue, advancing two long-pending STAGE-1-CANDIDATE joint theorems through the `joint-theorem-promotion.md` 4-stage pathway. Both gates are COMPUTE-class `[VERIFY]` gates whose verdict is a **PASS-AND aggregation** over per-axis cross-reviewer clause verdicts — not a numerical-threshold comparison. Neither gate re-derives new physics; each re-examines a **registered substrate-IS structural identity** from first principles via reviewers dispatched WITHOUT prior workshop context.

- **Item 18 — S100a-VIIW3LAB-STAGE2-VERIFY**: TWO-agent parallel cross-axis verify of §VII.W-3.LAB (Substrate Cocycle-Ratio Preservation Under χ Inheritance Morphism into 3He-B + 3He-A BdG observables; STAGE-1-CANDIDATE since S88 W4a-17; FWD-C3 / cross-pillar-bridge K-counter instance #3). PASS-AND → STAGE-3-PERMANENT with Stage-3-CLASS tag `JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND`.
- **Item 19 — S100a-VIIAM-STAGE2-VERIFY**: THREE-agent parallel cross-axis verify of §VII.AM (Universal Lock Condition: pixelation + effacement + Page-time locks; STAGE-1-CANDIDATE since S88 W1b2-65). atlas-09 flags it **Suspected-but-Not-Yet-Retracted** → a clause-level FAIL routes to retraction evaluation, so the gate is informative in BOTH directions (PASS → STAGE-3-PERMANENT; FAIL → atlas-09 retraction-route). This bidirectionality is pre-registered explicitly.

**Carry-forward source**: register-sourced (open-channel-ledger §C K5/K6; atlas-08 Q24/Q25). Neither item has a prior-session WP carry-forward block — both are recovered from the registered §VII entry text + the `joint-theorem-promotion.md` Stage-2 protocol.

**The S99 E1 reviewer-exclusion lesson is load-bearing for this wave.** S99 W3-1 E1 originally used a Stage-0 CO-AUTHOR as a cross-reviewer (a `joint-theorem-promotion.md` Stage-2 audit-item-3 violation, caught and re-dispatched at session close). The exclusion attaches to the registered §VII entry's STAGE-0 AUTHORSHIP (Sponsors / co-author lines), NOT merely prior column-computing gates. Both gate blocks below pin reviewer assignments that EXCLUDE all Stage-0 authors, cite the registry authorship-source line for each exclusion, declare the downstream-inheritance reach test as a dispatch-time check, and pre-register the substrate-input-orthogonality predicate.

## Wave 6 Decision Point Prerequisites

Wave 6 is **independent of all other S100a waves** (per `session-100a-partition.md` cross-wave dependency graph: "W6 (Stage-2 cohort: independent; reviewer-exclusion constraints pinned in context file)"). No upstream S100a verdict gates any item here.

The only upstream prerequisites are the **already-landed registered §VII entries** and their pinned anchor data files (all confirmed on disk at plan-freeze, 2026-06-03 — see the Input-SHA Ledger). If any registered-entry input file were absent at dispatch, the gate would honestly close per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md`; at plan-freeze all inputs are present, so no mechanical closure is anticipated.

**Plan-freeze process obligation (carried from S99 housekeeping §A, item 2, NOT a gate):** `_joint_theorem_independent_verify_audit.py` currently has NO registered-Stage-0-authorship cross-reference check (grep-verified 2026-06-03). The orchestrator adds this check during Phase 3 validation (audit-script extension; in-session, not deferred). Both gate blocks below pin the authorship-source lines explicitly so the extension has a concrete target.

# (7) substitution_chain — clause → verdict aggregation logic (no sign/direction physics claim; this is the conjunction-logic chain)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: V_A(c) = Axis-A (van-den-dungen-bridge-theorist) verdict on clause c ∈ {A1,A2,A3} ∪ {J1,J2,J3}.
    Definition 2: V_B(c) = Axis-B (landau-condensed-matter-theorist) verdict on clause c ∈ {B1,B2} ∪ {J1,J2,J3}.
    Definition 3: PASS-AND (joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"): a JOINT clause j PASSES iff V_A(j)=PASS ∧ V_B(j)=PASS (logical AND, NOT OR).
    Substitute (composite): composite = [∧_{c∈{A1,A2,A3}} V_A(c)=PASS] ∧ [∧_{c∈{B1,B2}} V_B(c)=PASS] ∧ [∧_{j∈{J1,J2,J3}} (V_A(j)=PASS ∧ V_B(j)=PASS)].
    Simplify: composite=PASS iff every own-axis clause PASSES in its owning reviewer AND every JOINT clause PASSES in BOTH reviewers.
    Canonical form: composite ∈ {PASS, FAIL, INFO} per operator.form (FAIL on any clause-FAIL; INFO on any clause-INFO absent FAIL).
    Direction: PASS-AND is strictly stronger than PASS-OR — a JOINT clause passing in only ONE reviewer does NOT satisfy the gate (this is the structural-independence guarantee; OR is FORBIDDEN per joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2" PASS criterion bullet 2).
    Conclusion: composite=PASS ⇒ §VII.W-3.LAB → STAGE-3-PERMANENT with Stage-3-CLASS tag JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND; composite∈{FAIL,INFO} ⇒ hold STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; FAIL clauses route to next-session remediation, INFO clauses logged Stage-2-INFO-deferred.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Stage-2 PASS-AND: both cross-reviewers independently PASS all own-axis clauses AND all JOINT clauses
  (logical AND). The registered §VII.W-3.LAB cross-pillar bridge survives structurally-independent
  two-agent cross-axis verify; §VII.W-3.LAB promotes STAGE-1-CANDIDATE → STAGE-3-PERMANENT with
  Stage-3-CLASS tag JOINT-CROSS-AXIS-STAGE-2-PASS-AND. Solution-space: the FWD-C3 inheritance-morphism
  bridge (cross-pillar-bridge K-counter instance #3) is confirmed at the permanent-results layer;
  the 3He-B/3He-A falsifier rows (#47-#54b) become STAGE-3-anchored laboratory predictions.
FAIL_meaning: >
  At least one reviewer returns FAIL on at least one clause. Stage-2 → 3 promotion BLOCKED; §VII.W-3.LAB
  stays STAGE-1-CANDIDATE; the FAILing clause(s) route to next-session remediation. Solution-space: the
  named clause is the structural weak point — e.g. a FAIL on J1 (cancellation theorem) would re-open the
  (Δ_B/Δ_A)^p-independence claim; a FAIL on A1 would challenge the cocycle-ratio's substrate-intrinsic status.
INFO_meaning: >
  No clause FAIL, but at least one clause returns INFO (Stage-2-INFO-deferred). §VII.W-3.LAB holds
  STAGE-1-CANDIDATE. The most likely INFO is on Axis-B clause B2 (Level-3 empirical anchor), which is
  experimentally DEFERRED to the 2027-2030 Lancaster MCT-3 / RHUL-Aalto LTL cycle — a reviewer may
  legitimately INFO-defer the empirical anchor while PASSing the structural Level-1/Level-2 clauses. This
